note: CC0 stand-ins for the sound effects held back from this repository (README.md): each is made for its slot - the same length to the sample, its loudest moment where the held file has it, levelled to the same maximum momentary loudness (BS.1770) with a -2 dBFS limiter and the true peak at or under -1 dBTP - from CC0 recordings (Kenney's Impact, Interface and Sci-Fi Sounds; two CC0 Freesound recordings), cut, layered, varispeeded and filtered, and from sound made in code (noise, oscillators, plucked strings, drums and bells). The game plays a stand-in only where the file its cue names is not served (src/audio/standIns.ts); a stand-in sits at the held file's path under cc0/.
licence: Every file here is CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), its sources too.
